sloka: अप्राप्य सदृशान् दाराननपत्यः प्रमीयताम् ।अनवाप्य क्रियाम् धर्म्याम् यश्यार्योऽनुमते गतः ॥२-७५-३५॥
transliteration: aprāpya sadṛśān dārānanapatyaḥ pramīyatām ।anavāpya kriyām dharmyām yaśyāryo'numate gataḥ ॥2-75-35॥

translations.english: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother die without winning a worthy wife and without begetting offspring and without performing religious deeds
